log_level.description: Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr.

bind_host.description: IP address or hostname the Cyborg API server binds to.

bind_port.description: Port on which the Cyborg API server listens.

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the API service.

enable_ssl.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for the API endpoint.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (required if enable_ssl is true).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (required if enable_ssl is true).

cors_allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS (e.g., ['https://dashboard.example.com']).

rate_limiting_enabled.description: Enable rate limiting for API requests.

rate_limit_threshold.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the period before rate limiting kicks in.

rate_limit_period.description: Time window (in seconds) for rate limiting.

keystone_username.description: Service username for Cyborg in Keystone.

keystone_password.description: Password for the Cyborg service user in Keystone.

keystone_cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for verifying Keystone TLS connections.

keystone_insecure.description: Set to 'true' to disable TLS certificate verification for Keystone.

accelerator_discovery_auto.description: Automatically discover acceleration devices on the host.

known_accelerators.description: List of manually configured acceleration devices (used when auto_discovery is false).

name.description: Human-readable identifier for the device (must be unique).

device_id.description: PCI device ID or unique serial/hardware identifier.

db_connection.description: Database connection string (SQLAlchemy format). Use PostgreSQL/MySQL in production.
